notes.title: NO MERCY RETRO FPS — Meet HMUR!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41597897/7a1b0c50bd906f5c52d1f351a9f6049f6e820b05.png"][/img]Greetings to all old-school shooter fans!

Let us introduce HMUR — a fast-paced retro FPS that throws you into a twisted, alternative version of the Soviet Union in the 1990s. Combining the insane mechanics of 90s shooters, Soviet sci-fi aesthetics, and a pounding hardbass soundtrack, the game becomes a relentless dance of speed, precision, and madness.

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3499560/HMUR/"][/dynamiclink]
You are Sergey, an ordinary worker. Something went terribly wrong, and now your only chance to survive is to be faster than death.  [/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to watch the trailer: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/embed/zVDyBBJkbxk?si=_PrHKJJWgoskLN9R"][/dynamiclink][/p]

[h2]PLAYTEST SIGN-UPS ARE NOW OPEN![/h2]
Want to be among the first to push HMUR to its limits? Sign up for the playtests right now on the game’s Steam page.  
When the playtests begin, you’ll receive a notification.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/c230685cb4e8eca1cb8c821061c7c2fb03d15bc4.jpg[/img]

WHAT AWAITS PLAYTEST PARTICIPANTS:
[list]
[*] One life and endless restarts — in the spirit of Hotline Miami.
[*] Maximum mobility: dodge, jump, flank your enemies.
[*] Non-linear levels — choose your path and adapt your strategy on the fly.
[*] Huge arsenal — shotguns, assault rifles, heavy weapons. But ammo is worth its weight in gold.
[*] Original soundtrack — techno, hardbass, and breakcore merging with the firefight into a single rhythm.
[*] The atmosphere of a secret Soviet facility in the grip of disaster.
[/list]

[h2]🏆 EXCLUSIVE REWARD:[/h2]
Complete the playtest build — and earn an achievement. Upon release, it will turn into a golden pistol skin. This is not just a weapon, but a symbol that you survived where others gave up.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/d722637b181d78f5ca45fba4570339a82a764422.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45728763/76bdbfb56a930ee05fad6db4fb7d286628267475.jpg[/img]

[h3]HMUR is created by a solo developer.[/h3]
By participating in the playtests, each of you becomes part of the game’s development story. Join the [url=https://discord.gg/TbvXbvzZTZ]Discord[/url] and become part of the community.

The game is also available on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch.

At its core this is a Souls-like game that features Metroidvania elements, filled with exploration and secrets to be found.

You're in for a great adventure inspired by games like Castlevania and Dark Souls. Bloodthirsty monsters, divine creatures and epic boss battles. The game’s story is shaped by choices that will define your journey.

[h3]Let's celebrate the game's launch![/h3]
In honor of the release, please watch the trailer and immerse yourself in the world of Makh-Abyss before fully exploring the story and finding out what actually happened after the death of Lord Derek Ericona.

notes.title: PATCH 2.0 OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[h2][b]We're absolutely delighted to announce PATCH 2.0 is now available![/b][/h2]

It has been a lot of time since we have started to work on Orange Cast. It has been a lot of fun developing this game from start to finish and we are all proud of the game we have developed.

Thank you to everyone who played The Game. The community helped us find bugs and helped to improve the final game.

******************************************************************************************
In other news, we have another exciting announcement to share!
Open word, naval action, piracy, fierce combat and sieges, role play, VR support - [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148560/Buccaneers/][u][i]Buccaneers![/i][/u][/url] is all that and more! Coming soon, in September! Please [b]wishlist and follow[/b] to support an awesome team of indie developers and naval history enthusiasts!
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1148560/Buccaneers/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36649981/c062e61ffa48e374d1b8acbe4d274cddf0e75bf5.gif[/img][/url]
******************************************************************************************

[previewyoutube=bxqT1yICYTs;full][/previewyoutube]

2.0 - GLOBAL UPDATE


- (!!!) Major GUI update - including the combat one. It should be much easier to swap weapons, watch HP and use abilities.
- (!!!) 3rd person camera was improved and a playable character now uses less room in it.
- (!!!) Plenty of animations (both PC and AI) improved - transitions between different animations, overall quality.
- (!!!) New sound effects for all guns, taking damage, movement, GUI and abilities.
- (!!) Added Hit Screen - now it’s much easier to observe when and how often the PC was hit.
- (!!) Hit Marks improved - visual and sound wise.
- (!!) Certain enemies had been rebalanced, now they fit better to the story and the learning curve.
- (!!) New voices and sound effects for numerous types of enemies.
- (!!) New GUI element - combat and damage efficiency for a gun you are holding.
- (!!!) Combat AI animations and behavior improved including: combat movement and navigation, aiming, turning, gore.
- (!) Alt, Ctrl, и Shift incorrect binding is fixed.
- (!) Better and more logical weapon and ammo drop.
- (!) Flying and racing mini-games significantly improved.
- (!) Lower sound volume of the Soviet scientific drones.
- (!!) By the community’s request, we added autoloot (ammo, grenades) upon approaching ammo crates.
- (!!) Dialogue window improved.
- (!!) Added Field Of View adjustment to the settings.
- (!!) Weapons swap improved - now it’s easier to loot and equip weapons.
- (!!) Combat rolls improved - they are now quicker, optimized and provide better damage protection.
- (!!) Now you can use more than one ability at once - we added separate cooldowns.

[h1]Ask The Dev[/h1]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/2JE3Uaz]Discord[/url] server and ask the dev.

notes.content:
[h3][b]Orange Cast demo will be available on Steam for a week!
[/b][/h3]
Check this [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=akMgUgjf6nY&feature=youtu.be]trailer[/url] out, tovarish!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36649981/ba2980e0fc11f2e3e60d3b608af3d9231357eb03.jpg[/img]
[h2]GAME SUMMARY:[/h2]
[b]Genre:[/b] TPS Action/RPG
[b]Platforms:[/b] PC, PS4 and Xbox One
[b]Game mode:[/b] Single-player
[b]Engine:[/b] Unreal Engine 4

[b]Inspired by:[/b]
LEVIATHAN WAKES (JAMES S.A COREY)
The storyline and the lore are deeply inspired by this awesome book series.

MASS EFFECT (2007)
Art design and narrative structure are similar to Orange Cast in many ways. And we are the fans.

STALKER (2007)
Mood, level design, Soviet themes. Except it is in Space.

[h3]Description[/h3]
[i]As humanity’s elite space trooper, you take on a heroic,
action-packed adventure throughout the galaxy. Explore
planets, protect colonies, and be the first to meet the
unknown! Dive into the original story inspired by James
S.A. Corey’s The Expanse series...[/i]

[i]Orange Cast is a third-person Action/RPG game.
Challenge a secret enemy who hides his presence in the
the darkness of this universe. 
Explore worlds, fight for them, and survive![/i]

[h3]Don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194050/Orange_Cast_SciFi_Space_Action_Game/]wishlist us[/url]![/h3]
... join our [url=https://discord.gg/2JE3Uaz][b]Discord[/b][/url] channel!

notes.title: Check the Live Stream!
notes.content:
[h2]Join us at the Summer Game Festival as we're playing through the Orange Cast Demo.[/h2]

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/broadcast/watch/76561198071985258][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36649981/3e11d27ed7ecf4802d1b7c967017cdc6b5aee1c4.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]About the game[/h1]
Orange Cast - is TP Action / RPG , an atmospheric adventure in a large-scale setting where Soviet and Western science fiction are combined itself.

Visit different locations. From sandy dry planets to massive space stations. Whole galactic sector to explore.Game has spirit of soviet and western sci-fi novels. This game is also inspired by Mass Effect game series, "The Expanse" and "Firefly" TV series.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36649981/006ca7567f696608ff0d774fa461a42ce9fd22e5.jpg[/img]

[h1]The story: [/h1]
[i]The year is 2046.
The Sion colony is under the attack of an unknown coalition of forces. Chaos erupts, civilians dying, defenses, and communications are gone. Amidst all this horror, your playable character awakens. He is  Uber-Unit. You and your character will be conducting an investigation to turn to light the mysteries of his awakening and even his very existence. The character is wearing a very special suit with a set of unique abilities, making him a very deadly force.

Imagine the world where all the greatest nations colonized Mars and built space fleets. You are humanity’s elite space trooper and you take on a heroic, action-packed adventure throughout the anomaly-based space system. Explore planets, protect colonies, and be the first who challenge unknown threats for the entire humankind!
[/i]

[h2]Ask The Dev[/h2]
You can ask anything about the game on our [url=https://discord.gg/2JE3Uaz][b]Discord[/b][/url] server

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1194050/Orange_Cast_SciFi_Space_Action_Game/
